clue.text: Go mad over new bird

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sitting over another comes first

parts.note: to go mad is to rave

explanation.surface: Someone goes wild with excitement over a newly spotted bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The raven is a large black crow-family bird.

clue.text: Tell where pupil should be

explanation.surface: Telling a pupil where to stand.
explanation.walkthrough: In British schools a 'form' is a class, so a pupil should be 'in form'.
explanation.definitionFit: To inform is to tell someone something; a pupil belongs in (a) form, the British word for a school class.

clue.text: Originally artistic

parts.note: someone who makes art in a fresh, original way has an inventive, imaginative gift

explanation.definitionFit: An imaginative, inventive person makes things that are new and artistic.

clue.text: Baseball all-rounder

parts.note: not a versatile player but a hit letting the batter run all round the bases

explanation.walkthrough: 'All-rounder' suggests a versatile cricketer; here it is a hit that takes the batter all round the diamond.
explanation.definitionFit: In baseball a hit that lets the batter circle every base and score is the classic big play.

clue.text: Making progress with each other, with close personal links

explanation.surface: Two people walking together, closely linked.
explanation.definitionFit: Two people walking with linked arms move forward together, and the phrase also means closely allied or intimate.

clue.text: Enter into fresh keeping

indicators.note: fresh suggests the words enter and into are made anew in a different order

explanation.surface: An invitation to come inside and stay somewhere new.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Enter into' looks like the instruction; its nine letters are the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Retention is the act of keeping or holding on to something.

clue.text: I hurried round with demonstration of special kind of overcoat

indicators.note: round says the word for hurried goes around the I

parts.note: hurried means ran
a proof is a demonstration that something is true

explanation.surface: Someone rushes around showing off a particular style of coat.
explanation.definitionFit: A coat that keeps out the wet is waterproof against showers, a specific type of outer garment.

clue.text: Variety of British water-plant

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass growing in water

explanation.surface: Describing one type of British aquatic plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A breed is a variety or strain of animal or plant.

clue.text: Almost debar alliance

indicators.note: almost means the word for debar loses its final letter

parts.note: to debar is to block

explanation.surface: Nearly excluding a political grouping.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloc is a group of nations or parties joined in a common cause.

clue.text: Last month to make speech and confer award

parts.note: December, abbreviated Dec, is the last month of the year
to orate is to make a speech

explanation.surface: In December someone gives a speech and hands out a prize.
explanation.definitionFit: To decorate someone is to honour them with a medal.

clue.text: Toiler at work made to hang about

indicators.note: at work suggests the letters of toiler are set working into a new order

explanation.surface: A labourer forced to wait around.
explanation.definitionFit: To loiter is to linger idly, dawdling without purpose.

clue.text: I am taking good to be a force in Africa

indicators.note: taking means the first piece has the next attached to it

parts.note: I am contracts to I'm
pi, short for pious, is crossword shorthand for good

explanation.surface: Someone resolving to be good and powerful on the African continent.
explanation.walkthrough: PI (pious) for 'good' is a crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: An impi was a Zulu regiment or armed band, a military body in southern Africa.

clue.text: Not pursued, we hear, being immoral

indicators.note: we hear says the word is chosen for its sound

parts.note: not pursued means unchased

explanation.surface: Someone left alone by suitors is nonetheless said to be loose-living.
explanation.definitionFit: Unchaste means sexually impure, lacking modesty or virtue.

clue.text: Sten destroyed sniper's position

indicators.note: destroyed signals the letters of the gun name are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A Sten gun is wrecked at a marksman's hideout.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sten was a British submachine gun of the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine-gun or sniper's nest is the concealed spot from which they fire.

clue.text: Work for prisoner, who committed this crime?

explanation.surface: Wondering which convict carried out a robbery.
explanation.definitionFit: A job done in jail is work on the inside; a crime done by someone within the organisation is a classic insider crime.

clue.text: Wind indicator shows front heading east

indicators.note: heading means the first piece goes at the head of the second

parts.note: the van is the front of an army or procession
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A weathercock showing a weather front moving east.
explanation.definitionFit: A weather vane turns to show which way the wind blows.

clue.text: Some want executioner to use stake

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few people want the headsman to use a wooden post.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition 'to use stake' does not substitute for the answer; 'stake' alone does, with 'to use' as link words.
explanation.definitionFit: In poker the ante is the stake each player puts in before the deal.

clue.text: White folk put up after a fall

definitions.text: White folk put up after a fall

parts.words: White folk put up after a fall
parts.note: not pale people or a stumble, but figures built after snow has fallen

explanation.definitionFit: Children build these white figures from snow once a heavy fall has settled.

clue.text: Conflict with whole sphere of operations

parts.note: the whole sphere is the globe, the world
military operations amount to war

explanation.surface: A battle fought across the entire globe.
explanation.definitionFit: A global war is the largest kind of armed conflict.

clue.text: Cleaner item of cutlery shortly filled with meat

indicators.note: filled with means the meat is put inside the shortened cutlery word
shortly says the cutlery word loses its last letter

parts.note: a spoon is an item of cutlery
ham is a meat

explanation.surface: A dirty spoon caked with meat needs a cleaning agent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cleaner' looks like a person; it is the definition, a cleaning product, and 'shortly' trims the cutlery word by its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Shampoo is a soapy liquid used for washing hair or carpets.

clue.text: How to bring in trimmer for line of shrubs

indicators.note: to bring in means the trimmer word is taken inside the word how

parts.note: an edger is a tool for trimming lawn borders

explanation.surface: A question about fetching a hedge trimmer to tidy bushes.
explanation.definitionFit: A hedgerow is a row of bushes forming a hedge along a field.

clue.text: Bear with betting system

explanation.surface: Putting up with a gambling arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: To tote is to carry, and the tote is the totalisator, a pool betting system at racecourses.

clue.text: Not a working port in the province

indicators.note: working suggests the letters of not a are put to work in a new order

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port, Rio for short

explanation.surface: A harbour that is out of action somewhere in a region.
explanation.definitionFit: Ontario is a Canadian province.

clue.text: Note briefly identifying this gas

parts.note: the single letter that abbreviates note is also the chemical symbol for this element

explanation.walkthrough: N is a short form of 'note' and the chemical symbol of the gas.
explanation.definitionFit: This element, a colourless gas making up most of the air, has the symbol N.

clue.text: Medal that may be struck

explanation.surface: A medal minted by striking metal.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Gong' is British slang for a medal or award, and a gong is a percussion disc hit with a beater.

clue.text: Initially, display over-tender emotion

indicators.note: initially says take the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A warning against being soppy.
explanation.definitionFit: To dote is to be excessively fond of someone.

clue.text: Foreign character has a few, to get tight

indicators.note: has means the first piece is followed by the second

parts.note: tau is a letter of the Greek alphabet
ten is taken as a small number, a few

explanation.surface: A stranger downs a handful of drinks and becomes drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: To tauten is to make or become taut, stretched tight.

clue.text: Condition of head of serpentine gallery

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of serpentine

parts.note: the Tate is a famous London art gallery

explanation.surface: The state of the boss of the Serpentine Gallery in London.
explanation.walkthrough: The Serpentine and the Tate are both London galleries.
explanation.definitionFit: A state is a condition, as in a state of disrepair.

clue.text: Grassland study is very dull

parts.note: lea is a poetic word for meadow
a den is a private study

explanation.surface: Studying a meadow is said to be tedious.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaden means heavy, dreary and lifeless.

clue.text: Given enough notice to regard as an equal

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
to equate is to treat as equal

explanation.surface: Someone given fair warning is treated as a peer.
explanation.definitionFit: Adequate means sufficient or satisfactory.

clue.text: Sally for ever!

parts.note: ay, also aye, is an old word for ever or always

explanation.surface: A toast or cheer: long live Sally!
explanation.definitionFit: A sally is a sudden sortie by troops, a raid.

clue.text: Quietly, I lose pounds in casino game — there's a twist

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for quietly

indicators.note: lose means the letter for pounds is dropped from the game

parts.note: roulette is a casino game
L stands for pounds, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: A gambler quietly loses money at the wheel, a turn of events.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lose' takes L out of ROULETTE, leaving ROUETTE.
explanation.definitionFit: A pirouette is a spin on one foot in ballet.
